content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm trying to figure out how to connect a contactor to my [product_name] module. For example, how to wire contactor points A1 or A2 with I1 and Q1. Any advice would be greatly appreciated!
Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. I'm not quite sure I understand your question. Could you please clarify what you mean so we can assist better?

Hi, thank you very much. I have 8 inputs and one terminal, plus 8 outputs. I want to know how to wire them, specifically how to connect my outputs to contactors. If you have any guidebooks or documentation for wiring, please share them. Thank you and sorry for my English.
Which specific [product_name] module do you have? Please provide the exact order number and type, such as 12/24RCE [article_no]. With this information, I can provide the correct manual for you.
Here is a link to the manual for the [article_no] standard version ([document]). Also, here is a link for the manuals covering versions 8.1 and 8.2 ([document]).

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion focuses on a user's difficulty in wiring contactors to a [product_name] module and their request for documentation or guidance. Community members respond by asking for specific product details and provide relevant manuals, highlighting the value users place on accurate and easy-to-follow wiring instructions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks clear and straightforward instructions or documentation on connecting contactors to their specific [product_name] module, expecting the guidance to be directly applicable to their unit's version.
